# netskope_ips_status (Data Source)

IPSStatus DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_ips_status" "my_ipsstatus" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `nonweb` (Boolean) Whether IPS is enabled for non-web traffic
- `npa` (Boolean) Whether IPS is enabled for NPA (private access) traffic
- `web` (Boolean) Whether IPS is enabled for web traffic
